actual_scope: For the selected complex body (the #5383 eight-relation word used by #5392/#5398/#5413) and its #4610 source, what is the exact number of extra fractional bits that makes every atomic cut exact on a fixed dyadic Gaussian grid, at every payload tensor depth lambda, and is it attained?
scope_change_reason: The selected record keeps precision_tape as a retained premise; for this word the repository only checks formal prefix l1 and denominators below a 2^192 envelope (eight-owned-relations/native.py). The P104 words have sharp exact-grid results (PR2772, PR2813, p104-joint-prefix-grid); this package supplies the corresponding sharp statement for the selected word instead of formalizing a new lemma. It is step 1 of target 7 in PR #5428.
bottleneck_link: Side result; no new kappa. It replaces an envelope check by an exact, attained grid for the selected local word, a precondition for any precision-weighted invoice or approximate-supplier analysis.
stop_rule: Stop at the exact attained guard for the two programs of the two pinned words; the #5413 caller packet and the recursive price of the guard are separate steps.
evidence: verify.py replays both programs of the eight-relation body and the #4610 source exactly over Q: all coefficients are dyadic; per-term Fourier ranks from the repository Clifford compiler (checked equal to the paid rank on every climb) give the Pareto front {(6,9)} backward and {(5,9)} forward, so the guard is ceil(9 lambda/2)+6 (backward) and +5 (forward); a witness term (coefficient -1/64, rank 9, its input occurring once) shows attainment; max coefficient l1 457. test_verify.py rejects five mutations.
